Hi Olga,

Quick heads-up from overnight setup: a floor hatch cover near Booth 12 has come loose and one of our team members tripped this morning (minor scrape, no ER). It's a trip hazard for attendees and our crew. Also the venue's main Wi‑Fi on the west hall has been flakey since early setup—lots of drops. We recommend limiting demos that rely on venue Wi‑Fi until we have a fallback.

Attached a picture from the crew and a quick note from James (venue ops).

Attachments: [attachment: floor-photo.jpg (image/jpeg)]

Can Redwood provide a cellular fallback (hotspots) for the booth and approve a temporary safety fix? Venue suggests a 2-hour fix from their vendor or we can have our contractor do a quick carpet plate over the hatch.
